name: codecraft-ai
description: Unlimited AI Coding Assistant for macOS

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:mac:dmg: npm run build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.electron:build:mac:zip: npm run build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --mac zip
